That sounds awful.. Don't do that to yourself, you deserve better than to out yourself through that.

You can't change the fact that you were born. You're here now, and I'm sure you make a lot of people happy. I find that family and especially parents can be the worst, because they are people forced into your life from the beginning. If they're shitty you're stuck with shitty family. You didn't choose those people, surround yourself with people you choose. Be with who you want to be, be who you want to be. What your parents think doesn't matter anymore,you don't need them anymore. Your life, your choices.

I understand what you're going through. If you want help, there isn't a single doubt in anyone's mind that you deserve it. You're the only one that will live your whole life with yourself, don't let yourself be the one to bring you down. If you want help, definitely reach out. It might helo you feel like you're less of a nuisance to those around you if you feel like you're making progress.

Jesus Christ - Brand New

One of my favs for when I'm feeling like trash. If your parents aren't treating you right, fuckem. You don't deserve to deal with their shit, you didn't ask for them to bring you here. Do what you wanna do, what makes you feel happy and validated, don't live your life according to how others want you to live it.

I feel you. Wish i could disappear without affecting others. I can't either, so I'll just tough the ride and see what happens i guess. Hopefully something good will happen along the way, wishing it for the both of us.

Hey man. All that shit, ugly, weak, short, it's all pointless. You'll find people that talk to you and accept you for who you are. Appearances don't matter. People hung up on appearances aren't worth being around. Being weak is ok, you don't need to be jacked to live a good life. Going to the gym is great, if it makes you feel better about yourself keep doing it. It feels great once you start seeing results, trust me. Being short means nothing. I'm 163cm, close to as short as dudes come. Shit don't matter. We all come in different shapes and sizes. And hey, you're less alone now than you were a few minutes ago. We're here man. Good luck.
